focus: touch transaction staging, narrow UI, wheel portability, emulated native touch, deferred storage contract

cases.baseline_risk: Touch point/two-click tools commit on pointerdown before second contact arrives
cases.correction: Deferring touch constructions to release; abort when another touch appears
cases.evidence: Synthetic Chromium PointerEvents: red on Cut14, green on Cut15

cases.baseline_risk: Final pointerup displacement can be unobserved if pointermove is absent
cases.correction: Touch-up movement limit and final pen pan coordinate processing

cases.baseline_risk: Secondary touch on canvas or tools panel interferes with a live gesture
cases.correction: Cancel captured drag and incomplete draft; block until all touch contacts have ended
cases.evidence: Synthetic primary+secondary contacts, SVG and cross-panel

cases.baseline_risk: Releasing an uncaptured pointer outside SVG strands active contact state
cases.correction: Window pointerup/pointercancel cleanup for contacts originating on canvas
cases.evidence: Synthetic outside release followed by a normal touch

cases.baseline_risk: A pending single-finger tap can commit after window blur
cases.correction: Invalidate pending touch state on blur and document visibility hidden
cases.evidence: Synthetic blur then delayed touch pointerup

cases.baseline_risk: Browser wheel deltaMode lines/pages treated as pixels, inconsistent zoom
cases.correction: Normalize line wheel (16px) and page wheel (canvas height), then clamp
cases.evidence: Synthetic WheelEvents: 16 pixel vs 1 line produces matching position

cases.baseline_risk: Mobile header overflow conceals Export and leaves horizontal page scroll
cases.correction: Wrap header controls, responsive stage layout, clipped horizontal overflow
cases.evidence: Emulated mobile Chromium at 320/390/700 px; native emulated tap

cases.baseline_risk: Native emulated touch PNG export needs end-to-end check
cases.correction: Preserve raster button and image generation after wrapped header and touch construction
cases.evidence: Chromium emulation at 390px; PNG signature + positive output dimensions

cases.baseline_risk: Stale queued storage commit could capture an obsolete state
cases.correction: No production storage change: explicit regression locks deferred commit until latest payload, stale token rejection
cases.evidence: Four new Node contract tests; synthetic mocked lock/storage, not real multi-tab

limits: Real physical multi-touch hardware, Safari touch, screen-reader interaction and true cross-origin or same-origin multi-tab atomicity not verified
Chromium mobile has_touch emulation is not a physical device
Web Locks contract test uses mock; browser network navigation blocked by sandbox
